announcement_item: 2026 NFL schedule powered by AWS to be released Thursday, May 14 (league announcement article)
what_it_says: The National Football League announced that the 2026 NFL Schedule powered by AWS will be released on Thursday, May 14 at 8 p.m. ET. Lists 2026 International Markets including Mexico City, Mexico (Estadio Banorte).
